checks: Passed: image integrity, normalized boxes, matching labels; no overlap of file/pixel/mirrored-pixel hashes, source keys, or groups between splits.
limitations: No verified patient identifiers: patient independence cannot be guaranteed.
Existing augmentation cannot reliably be reversed. Validation/test may include augmented images.
Perceptual similarity grouping is heuristic: may merge distinct images or miss related images; it is not a verified patient identifier.
Clinical class definitions and annotation accuracy require expert/source validation.
perceptual_method: 64-bit dHash on 9x8 grayscale, including horizontal reflection; Hamming distance <=4 and absolute log-aspect-ratio difference <=0.05. Conservative group union; no images deleted for perceptual similarity.
